description: Buddy Phase 7 — Execution Resilience & Operational Hardening. Phase 6 improved trade quality. Phase 7 hardens execution: stale data protection, atomic state writes, API retry/circuit-breaker, order recovery, slippage tracking, and config extraction. DIRECTIVE: NEVER STOP BRAINSTORMING/RESEARCHING AND IMPROVING. DONT ASK FOR EVERY COMMAND, JUST DO. ONLY ASK WHEN DESTRUCTIVE.

userStories.title: Data freshness gate before trade execution
userStories.description: As a precision system, orders must not execute on stale market data. If analysis is >60s old when execution begins, the trade should be skipped or price refreshed.
acceptanceCriteria: PairAnalysis in results.py gets analysis_timestamp field
execute_trade() checks (now - analysis_timestamp) < max_data_age_seconds (default 60)
If data too old, return ExecutionResult(success=False, error='stale data')
max_data_age_seconds configurable in ScannerConfig
Log stale-data skips to observations.jsonl
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Implemented in execute_trade() — checks scan_time from analysis_context, skips if age > config.max_data_age_seconds. Wired through engine.py passing scan_time ISO string.

userStories.title: Atomic JSON writes with file locking
userStories.description: As a resilient system, all JSON state files must use atomic writes (temp+rename) and file locking to prevent corruption from concurrent access.
acceptanceCriteria: New utility: src/scanner/automation/safe_json.py with safe_json_read() and safe_json_write()
safe_json_write uses temp file + fsync + os.rename pattern
safe_json_read with try/except falls back to .bak file on parse failure
Wired into execution.py trade_journal_rl.json writes
Wired into agents/_team.py agent_weights.json writes
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: safe_json.py: _FileLock (fcntl), safe_json_read (bak recovery), safe_json_write (temp+fsync+rename), safe_jsonl_append. Wired into execution.py (2 locations) and agents/_team.py.

userStories.title: OANDA API retry with exponential backoff and circuit breaker
userStories.description: As an operationally resilient system, transient OANDA API failures should retry with backoff, and persistent failures should trip a circuit breaker to avoid cascading errors.
acceptanceCriteria: New utility: src/scanner/automation/api_retry.py with retry_api_call() decorator
Exponential backoff: 1s, 3s, 10s (max 3 retries)
Circuit breaker: if >50% of last 10 calls fail, skip further calls for 60s cooldown
Auth errors (401/403) fail fast without retry
Wired into execution.py OANDA API calls (at least fetch_live_nav, monitor_open_trades)
Circuit breaker state logged to observations.jsonl when tripped
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: api_retry.py: CircuitBreaker class (deque window, configurable threshold/cooldown), retry_api_call with backoff. Wired into fetch_live_nav via _retry_oanda helper.

userStories.title: Order rejection recovery and fill status tracking
userStories.description: As a robust execution system, order rejections should attempt recovery (downsize and retry), and fill status should be tracked in journal entries.
acceptanceCriteria: ExecutionResult gets fill_status field: FULL, PARTIAL, REJECTED, RETRIED
On OANDA order rejection, auto-downsize by 50% and retry once
Journal entry only created AFTER successful fill (not before)
If order rejected twice, skip with logged reason
fill_status persisted in trade journal for pattern analysis
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Order loop with configurable max_order_attempts + rejection_downsize_factor. Journal moved after fill. fill_status on ExecutionResult.

userStories.title: Slippage tracking and execution quality metrics
userStories.description: As a self-monitoring system, every executed trade should track slippage (fill_price vs analysis_price) and log execution quality metrics for pattern extraction.
acceptanceCriteria: ExecutionResult gets slippage_pips field (fill_price - expected_price)
Journal entry includes slippage_pips and fill_price
execution_quality_summary() method returns avg slippage, max slippage, fill rate
Slippage > 5 pips logged as warning to observations.jsonl
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: slippage_pips on ExecutionResult, journal enriched, execution_quality_summary() method, high slippage threshold now configurable via config.

userStories.title: Extract hardcoded execution params to ScannerConfig
userStories.description: As a tunable system, critical execution parameters must be in ScannerConfig, not hardcoded in code.
acceptanceCriteria: ScannerConfig gets: tight_max_sl_pips, tight_max_tp_pips, high_prob_tp_bonus_pips
ScannerConfig gets: rl_weight_boost_on_win, rl_weight_penalty_on_loss
execution.py reads these from config instead of hardcoded values
agents/_team.py reads RL weight params from config
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: 9 params extracted: max_order_attempts, rejection_downsize_factor, high_slippage_alert_pips, fallback_tp_pips, fallback_atr_pips, min/max_lot_size, trailing_stop_breakeven/lock_pct. weight_boost_on_win and weight_penalty_on_loss were already in ScannerConfig from Phase 5.
